boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Tacoma’s 6th Avenue business corridor, which runs beside the University of Puget Sound area.

cards.title: Play from the board-game library
cards.subtitle: 6th Avenue corridor, Tacoma
cards.notes: On the 6th Avenue corridor, start in the café section, then use the separate pay-to-play board-game library in back.
cards.short_summary: A café with a dedicated board-game library.
cards.evidence_claim: The 6th Avenue Business District describes 15% Board Game Cafe as a coffee shop with food and seating plus a pay-to-play board-game library.
cards.access_notes: The board-game library is described as pay-to-play; confirm current availability with the business.

cards.title: Find the original 6th Avenue café
cards.subtitle: 6th Avenue corridor — 2201 6th Ave
cards.notes: Use the 6th Avenue corridor to reach Bluebeard’s original café at 6th and State; its site lists this exact Tacoma location.
cards.short_summary: Bluebeard’s original Tacoma café sits at 6th and State.
cards.evidence_claim: Bluebeard Coffee Roasters identifies its original 6th Avenue café at 2201 6th Ave, at the corner of 6th and State streets.
cards.source_title: Visit Our Cafe | Bluebeard Coffee Roasters
cards.access_notes: The business lists the 6th Avenue café as open daily, 7 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Stop at the 6th Avenue deli
cards.subtitle: 6th Avenue corridor — 2220 6th Ave
cards.notes: Follow the 6th Avenue corridor to MSM Deli’s listed address and use its current hours page to time a food stop.
cards.short_summary: A deli with a listed location on 6th Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: MSM Deli’s website lists its location as 2220 6th Ave, Tacoma, and identifies it as a deli restaurant.
cards.access_notes: The website lists daily hours of 10 a.m.–7 p.m.; verify current service before going.

cards.title: Browse records, books, and media
cards.subtitle: 6th Avenue corridor — 2714 6th Ave
cards.notes: Make Hi-Voltage a browsing stop on the 6th Avenue corridor; the storefront lists new and used records, books, CDs, DVDs, and cassettes.
cards.short_summary: An independent media shop on 6th Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Hi-Voltage Records lists its Tacoma storefront at 2714 6th Ave and says it carries new and used records, CDs, DVDs, cassettes, and more.
cards.access_notes: The store lists daily hours of 10 a.m.–7 p.m.; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Browse underrepresented voices
cards.subtitle: 6th Avenue corridor — 3116 6th Ave
cards.notes: Continue along the 6th Avenue corridor to Grit City Books and browse its curated shelves, which emphasize queer and other underrepresented stories.
cards.short_summary: A 6th Avenue bookstore with an explicitly inclusive curation focus.
cards.evidence_claim: The 6th Avenue Business District identifies Grit City Books as an expertly curated bookstore emphasizing queer and other underrepresented groups’ stories.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current store hours and event access directly with the bookstore.

cards.title: Look for flowers and design classes
cards.subtitle: 6th Avenue corridor, Tacoma
cards.notes: Use the 6th Avenue corridor for a flower-focused stop; Fifi’s lists arrangements, bulk flowers, gifts, and design classes.
cards.short_summary: A flower market with floral supplies and classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The 6th Avenue Business District says Fifi’s Flower Market offers flower arrangements, bulk flowers, design classes, and gifts.
cards.access_notes: Classes and purchases may require advance arrangements; check directly with the business.

cards.title: Browse the romance bookstore
cards.subtitle: 6th Avenue corridor, Tacoma
cards.notes: Add Shelf Indulgence to a 6th Avenue corridor walk when you want a bookstore devoted to romance titles and related browsing.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated romance bookstore on the corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The 6th Avenue Business District identifies Shelf Indulgence as Tacoma’s permanent romance bookstore, dedicated to celebrating love in all its forms.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current hours and inventory directly with the bookstore.

cards.title: Browse authentic vintage goods
cards.subtitle: 6th Avenue corridor, Tacoma
cards.notes: On the 6th Avenue corridor, visit Scorpio Rising to browse its stated selection of authentic vintage clothing and goods.
cards.evidence_claim: The 6th Avenue Business District describes Scorpio Rising as a Tacoma vintage shop specializing in authentic men’s and women’s vintage goods.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current hours and stock directly with the shop.

cards.title: Check the event calendar
cards.subtitle: 6th Avenue corridor, Tacoma
cards.notes: Use the 6th Avenue corridor to locate Avelon Ballroom, then check its calendar or contact it for an event appropriate to your visit.
cards.short_summary: An event venue with standing-room capacity for up to 200.
cards.evidence_claim: The 6th Avenue Business District describes Avelon Ballroom as an event space accommodating up to 200 people standing.
cards.access_notes: Entry, age guidance, and ticketing vary by event; verify details with the venue.

cards.title: Plan a daytime breakfast stop
cards.subtitle: 6th Avenue corridor — 3829 6th Ave
cards.notes: Travel the 6th Avenue corridor to Grit City Breakfast at its listed Tacoma address; its site posts daily morning-to-afternoon hours.
cards.short_summary: A breakfast destination with daytime daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Grit City Breakfast lists its location at 3829 6th Avenue, Tacoma, and lists daily hours of 7 a.m.–1 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The business lists daily breakfast hours of 7 a.m.–1 p.m.; verify current service before going.
